thesis: Core profit growth of 32.6%, positive FCF and a single-digit quoted multiple give the bull concrete support beyond a dividend narrative. Thin margins temper conviction but do not erase the normalized core improvement already reported.
strongest_counterexample: The operating margin is only 3.26%, and a higher forward multiple warns that current earnings or disposal effects may overstate valuation support.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if core annual profit falls year on year at the next full-year release.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if operating margin below 3% for two consecutive quarters.
evidence_gaps: Full core-to-reported earnings reconciliation and current dividend coverage.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Core profit growth, cash generation and dividends support a value-income case
Core profit growth is stronger evidence than headline reported profit, and the value thesis is credible enough to investigate
